ALTER TABLE teacher_decision
    ADD COLUMN learning_action_id UUID;

ALTER TABLE teacher_decision
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_decision_learning_action_context_check CHECK (
        (
            context_type IN ('lesson_task', 'practice_task', 'project')
            AND learning_action_id IS NOT NULL
            AND correlation_id = learning_action_id::text
        )
        OR
        (
            context_type NOT IN ('lesson_task', 'practice_task', 'project')
            AND learning_action_id IS NULL
        )
    ) NOT VALID;

CREATE INDEX teacher_decision_learning_action_idx
    ON teacher_decision (student_id, learning_action_id, created_at, id)
    WHERE learning_action_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TABLE teacher_integration_inbox (
    event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    event_type VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    correlation_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    causation_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    learning_action_id UUID NOT NULL,
    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (student_id, learning_action_id),
    CHECK (event_type = 'learning_action.closed'),
    CHECK (schema_version = 1),
    CHECK (btrim(student_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (correlation_id = learning_action_id::text),
    CHECK (btrim(causation_id) <> '')
);

ALTER TABLE teacher_learning_action_assistance
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_learning_action_assistance_observations_check;

ALTER TABLE teacher_learning_action_assistance
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_learning_action_assistance_observations_check CHECK (
        jsonb_typeof(observations) = 'array'
        AND jsonb_array_length(observations) BETWEEN 1 AND 300
    );

ALTER TABLE teacher_learning_action_assistance
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_learning_action_assistance_correlation_check CHECK (
        correlation_id = learning_action_id
    ) NOT VALID;
